caption: The drawing features two braided bands composed of brown material, possibly hair, depicted on a plain beige background. The upper band is shown with ornate gold-colored clasps at each end, attaching three oval-shaped medallions in the center, each displaying a small, black-and-white portrait of a person. These medallions are outlined with a gold border. A fine gold chain loops between the outer medallions and their adjacent clasps. The lower band is drawn below the first, shown from a side angle, and appears to have a sequence of four smaller gold-colored ovals linked together in the center, with the braided brown segments at each end. In the lower left corner of the image, the words "Westchester County" are written, and in the lower right corner, it states, "Drawn by Wm Shearwood."
title: Hair Brooch and Bracelet
